gamesPlayed.description: The total number of games played by the user.

avatarUrl.description: URL for the user's avatar image.

whiteUid.description: The UID of the player playing white.

blackUid.description: The UID of the player playing black.

status.description: The current status of the game.

winner.description: The UID of the winning player, or 'draw'.

timeControl.description: The time control for the game (e.g., '10+5').

fen.description: The current board state in Forsyth-Edwards Notation.

turn.description: Whose turn it is (white 'w' or black 'b').

whiteClock.description: Remaining time for the white player in seconds.

blackClock.description: Remaining time for the black player in seconds.

lastMove.description: The last move made in Standard Algebraic Notation (e.g. 'e4').

Move.title: Move
Move.description: Represents a single move in a chess game.

san.description: The move in Standard Algebraic Notation (e.g., 'Nf3').

fen.description: The board state in Forsyth-Edwards Notation after the move.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the move was made.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public user profile data, keyed by user ID.

/games/{gameId}/moves/{moveId}.description: A subcollection storing the sequence of moves for a game.
